blockers.title: 20 rendered capabilities are mock-only
blockers.detail: They render, but read fixtures rather than an API. Auth and public pages read no collection by design, and honest gap states (NO_BACKEND) are counted under BLK-013, not here. Cleared per capability as G4+ lands.

blockers.detail: They show an honest empty state naming the missing collection rather than fixture data. Cleared per capability as the API grows to serve it.
